issues.display_title: Issue #2083: docs: deployment guide for DevOps (docs/DEPLOY.md)
issues.main_description_html:
Background

There was no written guide for deploying GoThru-API-New. The steps (builder-server, composer install, ansible-playbook, workers and cron on apil-1) were only known by the people who ran them.

Goal

DevOps can deploy the API, check it, and roll it back by following one document in the repo.

Scope

  • docs/DEPLOY.md in English, written for DevOps, linked from the README.
  • Steps 1–3: before deploying: PR merged to main, env/database changes (/home/config/gothru-new-api/env.production, database.php), notify the team.
  • Step 4: run the deploy from builder-server: git pull, composer install, ansible-playbook ansible-deploy.yml, check PLAY RECAP.
  • Steps 5–7: after deploying: GET / returns 200, check logs, storage/ permissions.
  • Step 8: workers (pm2) and cron jobs on apil-1.
  • Rollback, PHP version policy (patched for CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619) and troubleshooting.
  • Docs only, no code changes.

Acceptance Criteria

  • AC-001: docs/DEPLOY.md exists on main and is linked from the README.
  • AC-002: The guide covers before deploy, deploy, after deploy, workers/cron, rollback and troubleshooting.

Related

  • gothru-dashboard and villume-admin have the same kind of guide (docs/DEPLOY.md).

Result

Implementation

  • PR: #2080 (merged into main 2026-10-22, 423670ad7): adds docs/DEPLOYMENT.md + README link.
  • PR: #2081 (merged into main 2026-10-22, 3d6ac4055): renames it to docs/DEPLOY.md, no content changes.
  • Guide: docs/DEPLOY.md

Open item: step 4.3 composer install flags still need DevOps confirmation (AC-003).
